absent_prime_construction.claim: None of the listed odd primes divides C(n,3), for all k>=1.

full_digit_construction.claim: Every listed p divides C(n,3), while Lucas gives C(n,j)=1 mod p.
full_digit_construction.limitation: j is fixed; these are not counterexamples and fail the eventual endpoint bound.

scope: Method limitations only; no new counterexample or full exclusion.
